resources.string: Checking the address on this phone’s network…
Checking the secure connection and personal address…
Loading the viewer, scripts, styles and install manifest…
Checking access to your glucose and history…
Confirming that this phone still owns this exact link…
This phone’s network cannot resolve the new address yet. DNS may take a few minutes. We will retry automatically; your saved history is unchanged.
The secure connection could not be verified. Check the phone’s date, internet or VPN. Certificate checks will not be bypassed.
This check has not passed on your phone yet. Internet, DNS or the server may still be recovering. We will retry automatically.
Latest sensor reading: %1$s. Link readiness does not mean the reading is current.
The link works. No sensor readings have reached this profile yet.
If an already-open browser still shows a DNS error, reload it after a short wait: its own DNS cache may update later.
Existing connection kept. Connect its history to a personal link below.
Connection changed in advanced settings. Your personal profile has not been overwritten.
Finish the pending chat operation, then retry. Your data is safe.
Cannot finish yet. Check internet and server, then retry. Setup will resume with the same ID.
This connection was not accepted. Check your server credentials in Backend settings.
This history already belongs to another installation. Nothing was replaced.
Server is busy or has reached its limit. Try again later.
Address created. Waiting for DNS and HTTPS. Your data is already connected; this continues automatically.
Eight real checks, including this phone’s network. Percentages show completed checks, not estimated time. 100% appears only after every check passes.
Your personal link will appear here.
Anyone with this link can view your glucose and forecast. They cannot edit your records. Share it only with people you trust.
Your readings, meals, insulin and forecasts stay separate from other phones. New profiles start with the standard forecast, without another person’s personal adjustments.
Connect this server’s existing history and forecast model to this phone. Nothing is deleted. This one-time action requires the current backend credential and is only for the owner of that history.
Use up to 24 lowercase English letters, digits or hyphens; start with a letter or digit. Or leave empty.
A random suffix keeps your link hard to guess. The old link stops receiving data. Already downloaded copies cannot be erased remotely. History and forecast stay unchanged.
